DashboardInfluencersInviteInfluencerForm.formSubtitle: Create a placeholder — influencer will claim it via Instagram login
DashboardInfluencersInviteInfluencerForm.howStep1: You create an invitation with the influencer's Instagram handle
DashboardInfluencersInviteInfluencerForm.howStep2: Influencer opens RecentGossips app and connects their Instagram
DashboardInfluencersInviteInfluencerForm.howStep3: If the handle matches, they see a "Complete your profile" screen
DashboardInfluencersInviteInfluencerForm.howStep4: Influencer verifies their phone and the account becomes active
